summary: Enhance your skills with our MEL for Program Improvement Training Course. Learn effective monitoring and evaluation techniques to drive impactful results.
lede: Monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) for program improvement helps program managers, MEL professionals, and other delivery teams use evidence to guide decisions. Participants learn to design actionable frameworks and indicators, plan practical data collection, and interpret performance trends to identify corrective actions. The course also covers adaptive management, learning cycles, and communicating findings to stakeholders so teams can track and improve program delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly use or manage MEL to improve programs and drive results.
modules: MEL for Program Improvement: The Mindset Shift
Designing MEL Frameworks That Drive Action
Defining Indicators That Actually Improve Performance
Adaptive Management: Using Evidence to Adjust Delivery
MEL in Complex Programs and Multi-Stakeholder Environments
Common Pitfalls That Block Program Improvement
Building Program Improvement Plans and Tracking Change
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of program management and experience in monitoring and evaluation. Familiarity with data analysis concepts is beneficial but not mandatory.
